observation_summary: The compiler throws a 'Property module$exports never defined' error when 'checkTypes' is enabled during the processing of CommonJS modules.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurred because the compiler was unconditionally injecting code to check for 'module$exports' in CommonJS modules, even when no such property was defined. When 'checkTypes' was enabled, this generated an error because the compiler could not resolve the property on the module object. The fix introduces a tracking mechanism (a Set) to record which modules actually define 'module$exports', and only injects the override code if the module is present in that set.
